description: Implement a full SPICE-class circuit simulator in Rust: MNA matrix formulation, nonlinear device models (diode, MOSFET, BJT, Verilog-AMS), sparse direct LU solver, Newton-Raphson DC analysis, Radau IIA / BDF transient integrators, threshold-crossing mixed-signal bridge, and output writers (Nutmeg, VCD, Parquet, PyO3).

userStories.title: Define CircuitGraph IR and NodeId; seed ground node
userStories.description: As a simulator core, I need a graph IR that represents circuit topology so all downstream analysis can traverse it uniformly.
acceptanceCriteria: CircuitGraph struct with NodeId type alias defined in the crate
Ground node (index 0) seeded automatically on construction
NodeId is a newtype wrapping usize with From<usize> and Into<usize> impls
cargo check passes with no warnings
userStories.notes: This is the foundational IR. Keep it minimal: nodes, edges, element handles. No analysis logic here.

userStories.title: Implement SPICE netlist tokenizer for R/L/C/V/I/VCCS/VCVS/CCCS/CCVS
userStories.description: As a simulator, I need to parse SPICE netlists so users can describe circuits in the standard format.
acceptanceCriteria: Tokenizer handles R, L, C, V, I, E (VCVS), G (VCCS), H (CCVS), F (CCCS) element lines
Handles .subckt, .ends, .tran, .dc, .ac, .op directives
Returns structured token stream; unknown lines produce a ParseWarning, not a hard error
Unit test: parses a simple RC circuit netlist and produces expected element list
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Extend SPICE parser for MOSFET, diode, and BJT instance lines
userStories.description: As a simulator, I need to extract semiconductor device instance lines with their parameter sets from netlists.
acceptanceCriteria: M lines (MOSFET) parsed: drain, gate, source, bulk nodes plus MODEL W= L= AD= AS= parameters
D lines (diode) parsed: anode, cathode, MODEL, AREA= parameter
Q lines (BJT) parsed: collector, base, emitter, MODEL, AREA= parameter
.MODEL cards parsed and stored in a model registry keyed by name
Unit test: netlist with one of each device parses without error
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Implement Verilog-AMS .vams subset parser
userStories.description: As a simulator, I need to read behavioral Verilog-AMS modules so mixed-signal designs can be described compactly.
acceptanceCriteria: Parses module header: port list with input/output/inout directions and electrical/logic disciplines
Parses analog block: contribution statements V(a,b) <+ expr and I(a,b) <+ expr
Handles idt(x, ic) and ddt(x) operators in expressions
Handles transition(x, td, tr, tf) and slew(x, sr, sf) operators
Returns an AST; does not evaluate yet
Unit test: parse a behavioral resistor module and check port/body structure
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Implement MnaMatrix sparse data structure with stamp API
userStories.description: As the MNA assembler, I need a sparse matrix structure that elements stamp into so memory stays proportional to circuit size.
acceptanceCriteria: MnaMatrix struct backed by a COO accumulator (row, col, val triples) that converts to CSR on demand
stamp(row: usize, col: usize, val: f64) API adds to the existing entry (not overwrites)
stamp_rhs(row: usize, val: f64) for the right-hand-side vector
reset() clears accumulated values without reallocating structural data
Unit test: stamp a 2x2 resistor stamp, convert to CSR, verify entries
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Implement MNA stamping for linear elements
userStories.description: As the MNA assembler, I need resistors, capacitors, inductors, and independent sources to correctly contribute their G/C/L stamps.
acceptanceCriteria: Resistor: conductance G=1/R stamped at (n+,n+), (n-,n-), -(n+,n-), -(n-,n+)
Capacitor (transient, backward Euler): effective conductance G_eff=C/h stamped same pattern; charge term on RHS
Inductor: branch-current extension with extra KVL row; L/h on diagonal
Independent voltage source: KCL current variable branch extension
Independent current source: RHS stamp at affected nodes
Unit test: 2-node resistor divider MNA matches hand-computed 2x2 matrix
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Implement MNA stamping for controlled sources (VCCS/VCVS/CCCS/CCVS)
userStories.description: As the MNA assembler, I need controlled source Jacobian stubs so the nonlinear solver can stamp them during Newton-Raphson iterations.
acceptanceCriteria: VCCS G_m: g_m stamped at output (n+,nc+) and (n-,nc-) cross-entries
VCVS E: branch current extension; controlling voltage enters via KVL row
CCCS F: branch current of sensing element scales output current contribution
CCVS H: combined branch current extension for sense and output
Unit test: VCCS stamp matrix entries match textbook Sedra-Smith example
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Implement topology validator (floating nodes, V-source loops, inductor loops)
userStories.description: As the simulator front end, I need early detection of unanalyzable topologies so users get actionable errors instead of a singular matrix.
acceptanceCriteria: BFS from ground detects floating nodes; returns TopologyError::FloatingNode(Vec<NodeId>)

node_index(name: &str) -> Option<usize> and var_name(index: usize) -> Option<&str>

userStories.title: Implement VerilogAmsBlock behavioral model via idt/ddt trapezoidal approximation

userStories.title: Write device model verification tests

MOSFET: saturation region I_D at Vgs=1.5V, Vds=2V matches Level 1 formula

userStories.title: Implement SparseLU: Markowitz pivot selection and factorize/solve API
userStories.description: As the Newton-Raphson solver, I need a sparse direct LU factorizer so large circuit matrices are solved in near-linear time.
acceptanceCriteria: SparseLU::factorize(&mut self, a: &CsrMatrix) -> Result<(), SingularMatrix>
SparseLU::solve(&self, rhs: &[f64]) -> Vec<f64>
Markowitz pivot selection to minimize fill-in
Partial pivoting with threshold 0.1 for numerical stability

userStories.title: Implement NewtonRaphson: Jacobian assembly and convergence check
userStories.description: As the DC solver, I need Newton-Raphson iteration over device stamps so nonlinear circuits reach a consistent operating point.
acceptanceCriteria: Assembles G (Jacobian) from all DeviceModel::stamp_nonlinear calls at current solution
Solves G·Δx = -f via SparseLU; applies update x += Δx
Convergence: ||G·x - b||∞ < i_tol AND ||Δx||∞ < v_tol (defaults: i_tol=1e-9, v_tol=1e-6)
Returns Ok(solution) or Err(ConvergenceError { iteration, residue_norm }) after max_iter (default 150)
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Implement Gmin insertion diagonal shunting
userStories.description: As the DC convergence engine, I need Gmin shunting to regularize singular or ill-conditioned Jacobians.
acceptanceCriteria: GminInserter adds Gmin (default 1e-12 S) to all nonlinear-device terminal diagonal entries in G
Gmin is additive and does not modify original element stamps
Unit test: Gmin-augmented matrix of a simple diode circuit is non-singular when plain NR would be singular
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Implement HomotopyEngine::gmin_stepping
userStories.description: As the DC convergence engine, I need Gmin stepping as a robust fallback when plain NR fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Ramps Gmin from 1e-3 S down to 1e-12 S in 10 log-spaced steps
Each step starts NR from the previous step's solution
Returns Ok(DcSolution) if final step converges; Err(ConvergenceError) otherwise
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Implement HomotopyEngine::source_stepping
userStories.description: As the DC convergence engine, I need source ramping as a second fallback when Gmin stepping is insufficient.
acceptanceCriteria: Ramps all V/I source values from 0 → full value in 10 linear steps
Each step NR-initialized from previous solution
Returns Ok(DcSolution) on final-step convergence; Err(ConvergenceError) otherwise
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Implement DcAnalysis::run orchestrating NR → Gmin → source stepping
userStories.description: As the simulator, I need the full DC analysis driver that automatically falls through to homotopy when plain NR fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Attempts plain NewtonRaphson first
On ConvergenceError falls through to gmin_stepping
On second ConvergenceError falls through to source_stepping
Returns DcSolution { node_voltages: Vec<f64>, branch_currents: Vec<f64> } or ConvergenceError
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Write DC analysis verification tests

userStories.title: Implement RadauIIA 3-stage order-5 integrator
userStories.description: As the transient solver, I need Radau IIA to handle stiff DAE systems arising from circuits with widely separated time constants.
acceptanceCriteria: Implements the Butcher tableau for 3-stage Radau IIA (coefficients from Hairer-Wanner)
Stage system assembled and solved via Newton iteration (reuse SparseLU)
Embedded error estimate (via difference of stage solutions) drives LTE computation
RadauIIA::step(t, h, x) -> (x_new, lte_estimate)
Unit test: integrate dx/dt = -1000x (stiff scalar) from t=0 to t=0.01 with h=0.001; error < 1e-8
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Implement BDF1 and BDF2 integrators with history buffer
userStories.description: As the transient solver, I need BDF methods as an alternative stiff integrator with good phase accuracy for oscillatory circuits.
acceptanceCriteria: BDF1 (backward Euler) and BDF2 coefficient tables implemented
History buffer stores previous two solution vectors
LTE estimate via Richardson extrapolation between BDF1 and BDF2
Bdf::step(t, h, x) -> (x_new, lte_estimate); BDF order selected via config
Unit test: BDF2 integrates the stiff RC example to within 0.1% of analytic solution
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Implement adaptive step controller (accept/reject, grow/shrink, h_min/h_max)
userStories.description: As the transient engine, I need automatic timestep control so accuracy is maintained without excessive computation.
acceptanceCriteria: Accept step when LTE < rtol*||x||∞ + atol (defaults: rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-6)
Reject and halve h on LTE violation; grow by factor 1.5 when LTE < tol/10
h clamped to [h_min, h_max] at all times
After 5 consecutive rejections returns IntegrationError { t, lte, h }
Unit test: controller correctly accepts a step where LTE=tol/2 and rejects where LTE=2*tol
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Implement TransientAnalysis::run with waveform sampling
userStories.description: As the simulator, I need the transient driver that steps from t_start to t_stop and collects node waveforms.
acceptanceCriteria: Loops: assemble MNA, call configured integrator (RadauIIA or BDF), call adaptive controller
On accepted step: sample all node voltages and branch currents into waveform buffers
Returns TransientSolution { times: Vec<f64>, waveforms: HashMap<String, Vec<f64>> }
On IntegrationError, returns Err with the failing timepoint

userStories.title: Write transient analysis verification tests
